domains.name: session-coordination
domains.description: Per-session CLI and sidecar control paths that declare work to Concordia while keeping optional observability outside the control dependency chain.

modules.name: task-declaration-cli
modules.description: Short-lived CLI entrypoint and sidecar relay for task get/set declarations.

modules.name: optional-observability-boundary
modules.description: Best-effort Vestigium adapter used only by long-running providers and the local agent, never by short-lived task declaration commands.

domains.name: permission-governance
domains.description: Claude permission routing in which PreToolUse only records observations, Notification proves a human prompt, and fixed keystrokes relay remote answers.

modules.name: claude-native-decision-boundary
modules.description: Record every PreToolUse call without emitting a proxy decision in any permission mode, preserving Claude Code's native permission policy.

modules.name: stopped-for-a-human-trigger
modules.description: Raise coordinator cards only from permission-waiting Notifications and answer them through fixed, bounded-lifetime TUI keystrokes.

modules.name: permission-audit-trail
modules.description: Record and reconcile permission events with matched settings rules and prefix-evasion markers.
